ideas.title: CGM Data Aggregator API
ideas.description: A unified API that connects to Dexcom, Libre, and Medtronic CGM systems. Developers could build apps without dealing with each proprietary API. Charge per API call.
ideas.notes: Could be the foundation for AvaDrive and other diabetes apps. You already have Dexcom working - expand to others.

ideas.title: Mobile Home Service Marketplace
ideas.description: Like Thumbtack but specifically for manufactured home services - setup crews, leveling, skirting, plumbing. Connect homeowners with vetted contractors.
ideas.notes: Natural extension of FieldSync. You already understand the industry pain points from the inside.

ideas.title: Diabetes Camp Simulation Mode
ideas.description: Partner with diabetes camps to use AVA Type 1 as a training tool. Kids practice management in accelerated time before going on real pumps.
ideas.notes: B2B revenue stream for the AVA app. Camps would pay for licenses.

ideas.title: NFC Sticker Packs for AVA
ideas.description: Physical NFC stickers kids can scan to trigger in-game events (eating food, exercise, etc.). Sell as expansion packs. Makes the game tangible.
ideas.notes: Low cost to produce, high margin. Creates physical product line alongside app.

ideas.title: FieldSync → QuickBooks Integration
ideas.description: Auto-generate invoices from completed walkthroughs. Sync materials costs. Time tracking for hourly billing. Contractors would pay for this.
ideas.notes: This is where the money is in FieldSync. Accounting integration = premium tier.

ideas.title: Warranty Claim Automation
ideas.description: AI reads walkthrough notes and photos, auto-fills manufacturer warranty claim forms. Saves hours per claim. Sell to service companies.
ideas.notes: This is a huge pain point you experience directly. Could integrate with FieldSync or standalone.

ideas.title: AVA Arcade - Mini Games Collection
ideas.description: Standalone app with diabetes-themed mini games from AVA Type 1. Free with ads, or bundle with main app.

ideas.title: Service Tech Training Platform
ideas.description: Video courses + certification for manufactured home service technicians. Partner with manufacturers for official certs.
ideas.notes: Industry has no standardized training. First mover could own this space.

ideas.title: AVA Home — Matter Smart Bulb CGM Alerts
ideas.description: Connect CGM glucose data to Matter-compatible smart home devices via Apple HomeKit. Flash lights red for lows, yellow for highs. Visual alerts you can't miss even when phone is in another room. Huge for nighttime lows — bedroom light flashes, harder to sleep through than phone buzzing.
ideas.notes: HomeKit API is straightforward (difficulty 3/10). Could be a feature of AvaDrive, AVA Heart, or standalone AVA Home module. Reference bulb: OREiN Matter Smart Bulb 4-pack (https://a.co/d/5kKmDSp). Supports Apple Home, Alexa, Google, SmartThings.

ideas.title: T1D Benefits Navigator
ideas.description: App that matches T1D families with patient assistance programs (PAPs) based on income, insurance status, and medication/supply needs. Input info once, see which programs you qualify for, pre-fill applications. Nobody does this well today.
ideas.notes: ✅ BUILT: Full production PWA deployed to https://t1d-benefits-navigator.pages.dev. Comprehensive PAP database with 30+ programs, smart eligibility scoring, application guidance, installable PWA. React + Vite + Tailwind stack. GitHub: https://github.com/ava-type1/t1d-benefits-navigator

ideas.title: AvaDrive MQTT: Whole House RGB Takeover
ideas.description: Every RGB light strip and smart bulb in the house syncs to the same color based on glucose. Urgent low = entire house turns red simultaneously. Film at night for viral video potential.
ideas.notes: MQTT integration idea for AvaDrive. Visual impact is huge — shareable on TikTok/Instagram. Easy to demo with a few Hue bulbs + LED strips.

ideas.title: AvaDrive MQTT: Smart Mirror BG Display
ideas.description: Bathroom mirror shows glucose reading while getting ready in the morning. See your BG while brushing teeth. Raspberry Pi + two-way mirror + small display.
ideas.notes: MQTT integration. Smart mirrors are trendy in maker community. Natural daily touchpoint.

ideas.title: AvaDrive MQTT: Fridge Magnet Display
ideas.description: Small ESP32 display stuck to the fridge. Ironic placement — you see your BG right as you're reaching for a snack. Could flash warnings before you grab carbs.
ideas.notes: MQTT integration. Humorous angle for content. 'My fridge judges me now.'

ideas.title: AvaDrive MQTT: Motorcycle/Bike Helmet HUD
ideas.description: Tiny display or LED strip inside helmet visor shows glucose at a glance. Critical for riders who can't check phones. Safety angle is huge.
ideas.notes: MQTT integration. Niche but passionate audience (T1D motorcyclists). Could save lives.

ideas.title: AvaDrive MQTT: Treadmill/Gym Mount
ideas.description: Mount the portable display on gym equipment. See BG while working out without stopping. Exercise affects glucose — real-time visibility during workouts is valuable.
ideas.notes: MQTT integration. Fitness community crossover. Demo video at the gym.

ideas.title: AvaDrive MQTT: Gaming Overlay/Pause
ideas.description: Push glucose alerts as overlay on gaming PC/console. Optional auto-pause for urgent lows. 'My PS5 pauses Fortnite when my BG drops.'
ideas.notes: MQTT integration. Huge with T1D gamers and gaming parents. MQTT → Home Assistant → PC macro or smart plug.

ideas.title: AvaDrive MQTT: Backyard/Pool Speaker Alerts
ideas.description: Outdoor speakers announce glucose alerts when you're in the yard, garage, or by the pool. Voice alerts: 'Kaislyn is 65 and dropping.'
ideas.notes: MQTT integration. Practical for parents doing yardwork. Can't miss an announcement.

ideas.title: AvaDrive MQTT: Nightstand BG Clock
ideas.description: Replace bedside alarm clock with BG display. Wake up, see your glucose immediately. Doubles as night light with color-coded glow.
ideas.notes: MQTT integration. Simple, practical, daily use. Could sell as a kit.

ideas.title: AvaDrive MQTT: Car Cupholder Mount
ideas.description: Custom 3D-printed cupholder adapter for the portable display. Perfect positioning while driving. Doesn't block vents or windshield.
ideas.notes: MQTT/portable display accessory. Practical car use case. Could sell the STL or printed mount.

ideas.title: AvaDrive MQTT: Bubble Machine Alert (Kids)
ideas.description: Bubble machine activates when BG goes low. Fun, non-scary alert for young kids. 'Time for juice — look, bubbles!' Makes treating lows less traumatic.
ideas.notes: MQTT integration. Viral potential with kids content. Wholesome angle. MQTT → smart plug → bubble machine.

ideas.title: AvaDrive MQTT: Vibrating Wearable Band
ideas.description: Simple wristband or ankle band that vibrates for alerts. Different patterns for different urgency. Works when you can't hear or see alerts.
ideas.notes: MQTT integration. Great for deaf/HoH community, heavy sleepers, loud environments. ESP32 + vibration motor.

ideas.title: AvaDrive MQTT: Nerf Gun Wake-Up (Viral Joke)
ideas.description: Motorized Nerf gun fires foam dart at sleeping person for urgent lows. Obviously a joke/viral video concept. 'Level 3 alert: physical intervention.'
ideas.notes: MQTT integration. Purely for viral content — not a real product. Would get millions of views.

ideas.title: 🔧 Ralph Wiggum - Autonomous Loop Plugin
ideas.description: Run Claude Code autonomously for hours. Sets up a self-referential feedback loop where Claude keeps working on a task until completion. Named after the Simpsons character.
ideas.notes: INSTALL: /plugin install ralph-wiggum@anthropic-agent-skills | USE: /ralph-loop 'Build feature X' --max-iterations 10 --completion-promise 'DONE' | Great for longer tasks like building entire features while you do other work. GitHub: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/tree/main/plugins/ralph-wiggum

ideas.title: 🔧 XcodeBuildMCP - iOS Build Integration
ideas.description: MCP server that lets Claude Code build, run, and test your iOS/macOS projects directly. No more copy-pasting build errors — Claude sees them in real-time.
ideas.notes: INSTALL: npm install -g xcodebuildmcp@beta | CONFIG: Add to ~/.config/claude-code/mcp.json | Perfect for AVA Type 1 development. Claude can build, run simulator, see errors, fix them automatically. GitHub: https://github.com/cameroncooke/XcodeBuildMCP

ideas.title: 🔧 Swift/iOS Development Skill
ideas.description: Official skill that teaches Claude Swift 6 standards, modern SwiftUI patterns, @Observable macro, async/await best practices. Makes Claude way better at iOS code.
ideas.notes: INSTALL: /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills then /plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills | Or download from mcpmarket.com/tools/skills/developing-with-swift | Enforces modern patterns you want in AVA apps.

ideas.title: 🔧 ESP-IDF MCP Server
ideas.description: MCP server for ESP32 development using ESP-IDF framework. Claude can build, flash firmware, and auto-fix build errors for your ESP32 projects.
ideas.notes: INSTALL: Clone https://github.com/nicholasgriffintn/esp-mcp | CONFIG: claude mcp add-json 'esp-run' with IDF_PATH set | Perfect for AvaDrive ESP32 display firmware. Claude can flash directly to connected device.

ideas.title: 🔧 Embedded Systems Skill
ideas.description: Skill for firmware development on STM32, ESP32, and Nordic platforms. Teaches Claude embedded patterns, memory constraints, real-time considerations.
ideas.notes: Download from mcpmarket.com/tools/skills/embedded-systems-engineer | Improves Claude's ESP32 code quality for AvaDrive hardware projects.

ideas.title: 🔧 Context7 MCP - Live Documentation
ideas.description: Gives Claude access to up-to-date, version-specific documentation for any library. No more outdated API suggestions — pulls current docs directly.
ideas.notes: INSTALL: npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcp-context7 | Especially useful for fast-moving libraries like SwiftUI, ESP-IDF. Claude always has current API info.

ideas.title: 🔧 Cloudflare Workers Skill
ideas.description: Official Cloudflare skill for deploying Workers, KV, R2, D1, Pages. Claude knows the latest Wrangler commands and best practices.
ideas.notes: GitHub: https://github.com/cloudflare/skills | Useful for Command Center, Benefits Navigator, and other Cloudflare deployments. Claude handles wrangler config correctly.

ideas.title: 🔧 Anthropic Official Skills Pack
ideas.description: Bundle of official skills from Anthropic: document creation (docx, pptx, xlsx, pdf), web artifacts builder, MCP builder, webapp testing, skill creator.
ideas.notes: INSTALL: /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills | /plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills | /plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills | Good baseline of capabilities.

ideas.title: 🔧 React Native Skill (Vercel)
ideas.description: Official skill from Vercel team for React Native best practices and performance. If you ever build AVA apps for Android too, this is essential.
ideas.notes: GitHub: https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills/tree/main/skills/react-native-skills | For potential cross-platform AVA development.

ideas.title: 🔧 Expo Skill - React Native Builds
ideas.description: Official skill from Expo team. If AVA Type 1 ever goes cross-platform with React Native + Expo, this handles builds, EAS, and deployment.
ideas.notes: GitHub: https://github.com/expo/skills | Future consideration for Android version of AVA apps.

ideas.title: 🔧 Sentry Skill - Error Tracking
ideas.description: Official Sentry skill for error tracking and monitoring. Claude can set up Sentry, query errors, and help debug production issues.
ideas.notes: GitHub: https://github.com/getsentry/skills | Useful when AVA apps are in production and you need crash reporting.
